capabilities: Replace link text with a placeholder property value in view mode
Configure which property name supplies the placeholder
Toggle whether link names override placeholders
Customize separators for headers and blocks in link text
Disable placeholders per link with a special link name
extras: Usage examples are provided as videos and images, which are stripped from the text README, so some setup steps are only visible in those media.
problem: Obsidian always shows the link name (or note title) for links in view mode, with no way to display custom placeholder text instead.
summary: Link display plugin that substitutes a note link's visible text with a placeholder value from a note property in view mode.
